feature: ADR-0158 simultaneous keyboard IR and bounded lookahead/active-up protocol
initial_failures: Initial member observations assumed DueEvent Clone. Kept original DueEvent non-Clone and uniquely owned; added read-only copied ChordObservation metadata instead. Active Up now borrows original receipt for actual binding admission.
JSON fixture initially used unsupported json! array-repeat syntax; corrected to explicit Value::Array of cloned JSON values.
Full workspace compile found one explicit MappingExtras fixture missing new simultaneous=None field; filled metadata without changing lifecycle assertions.
Clippy flagged large owned rejected receipt result; boxed RejectedChordEvent while retaining original event and cold rejection state.

windows.scope: Native Windows compilation remains pending after prior automatic approval quota rejection; no new native attempt, bypass or valid capture/session.

limitations: No simultaneous runtime/binding implementation existed. New typed keyboard IR and pure protocol are prerequisites, not a completed remapper feature. Compile preserves raw JSON and parsed IR but emits KW-SIM-001 and disabled rule; Legacy/staged cold constructors reject UnsupportedSimultaneous, normal selector skips chord. Offline host mode tests reject without body leakage or file mutation.

Parser supports distinct 1..32 standard keyboard keys, modifiers, all down/up orders, uninterrupted flag, any/all, options after-up actions and profile/rule thresholds. Effective threshold follows upstream 1000ms clamp/default50ms; raw unchanged. Invalid/unknown fields and same-rule failed sibling refuse whole rule.

ChordWindow retains <=256 original receipts, first matching key/device source, inclusive earliest-time window and independent actual delivery clock. Maturity needs source frontier; strict Up waits n-1 prefix or mature window and does not retrospectively constrain future Up. Original source provenance/clock/capacity reject returns owned incoming unchanged; match/replay returns original buffer.

ActiveChord records saved participants and independently emits any/all output-release and all-up branch facts once. It borrows original Up so caller retains receipt; outside/duplicate/foreign/early Up cannot release. No native output or resource recovery claim.

24 new tests cover all option families, inclusive/zero/max-key boundaries, queued-frontier maturity, exact replay/owned rejection/cross-device duplicate/early Up/provenance/capacity, strict Up and any/all independent facts, caller Up ownership, typed runtime/single-key gate, parsing/metadata/threshold/whole-rule loss and offline host privacy.

Ordered candidate arbitration, Complex shared-group ownership/scopes/lease, normal replay, full branches/device/reset/repeat and actual runtime integration remain required before gates can be removed. Native pointer/platform/hardware, GUI/packaging/driver and full objective also remain incomplete.
abi: Pure Rust IR/observation/owned receipt protocol; no new unsafe/FFI/dependencies/native packet layouts. DueEvent public Clone was not added.
